definitions.gloss: again and again, repeatedly, over and over
definitions.explanation: Describes something done multiple times, often implying insistence or persistence.

examples.japanese: {再三|さいさん}⟦{注意|ちゅうい}した→注意する：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦くれなかった→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: I warned him repeatedly, but he wouldn't listen.

examples.japanese: {再三|さいさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{お願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{関|かか}わらず→関わる：03020_kakawaru⟧、⟦{断|ことわ}られた→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧。
examples.english: Despite repeated requests, I was refused.

examples.japanese: {再三|さいさん}⟦{再四|さいし}→再四：noentry⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I was told over and over again.

notes:
{再三|さいさん} emphasizes that something was done multiple times, often with the implication that efforts were unsuccessful or went unheeded. It carries a somewhat formal, written tone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {再三|さいさん}⟦{注意|ちゅうい}する→注意する：01464_chuui⟧: to warn repeatedly
- {再三|さいさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{要求|ようきゅう}→要求：03658_youkyuu⟧: repeated demands
- {再三|さいさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦わたって→わたる：noentry⟧: on multiple occasions

EMPHATIC FORM:
{再三|さいさん}⟦{再四|さいし}→再四：noentry⟧ — an intensified version meaning "again and again and again."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: many times (neutral, everyday)
- ⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}し→繰り返し：10320_kurikaeshi⟧: repeatedly (can be noun or adverb)
- ⟦{度々|たびたび}→度々：00397_tabitabi⟧: often, frequently (polite register)
